name: Farmshare Austin
tagline: Farmshare Austin — Apples in Cedar Creek, TX
description: In Cedar Creek, TX, Farmshare Austin raises Blackberries, Pumpkins, Tomatoes, Peppers, and Flowers on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer and autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
